name: PingProtect
short: Create groups of users who cannot be pinged.
description: Create named protection groups and add members to them. When a non-privileged user mentions a protected member, the bot deletes the message (and/or warns). Supports per-group actions and role/user bypasses.
author: Garsooon
install_msg: Thanks for installing PingProtect! Use `[p]pingprotect` to get started. Create a group with `[p]pingprotect create <name>` and add members with `[p]pingprotect add <name> <member>`.
